models.gpt-6.1-sol: Preferred general implementation model; broad repository edits and ordinary full-stack development. Starter preference, not a measured benchmark.
models.gpt-6-luna: Prefer for narrow read-only exploration or bounded documentation lookup with sufficient context. Escalate ambiguous, consequential work.
models.gpt-6-astra: Prefer for consequential architecture, difficult diagnosis, and substantial independent review, when that added analysis is justified.

skills.diagnose: Reproduce, minimize, gather evidence, and diagnose a failure.
skills.code-review: Review implementation against requirements and repository standards.
skills.tdd: Test-first implementation of a feature or bug fix.
skills.impeccable: Frontend interface design and visual polish.
skills.technical-debt: Focused audit of duplication, complexity and maintainability.
skills.browser-automation: Explicit browser testing and UI verification.
